Subject: Onsite visit playbook & badging plan for Bixby exec offsite

Hi Elaine —

Thanks again for hosting the executive workshop at Bixby the week of May 5. To make check-in smooth for both teams, I put together a short onsite playbook and a one-click request: can you confirm the badging process and the primary security contact?

High-level plan (Redwood attendees):
- Laura Bennett (Director, Customer Success) — arrival 05/05 08:30
- Marcus Lin (Eng Lead, Runtime) — arrival 05/05 08:45
- Stephanie Nguyen (Solutions) — arrival 05/05 09:15

What we need from Bixby:
1) Confirmation whether guests can pre-register with full name + company + DOB or last 4 of passport/ID.
2) Whether photos are required for visitor badges (we can upload).
3) Any escort requirements or restricted areas to avoid (we'll pass to teams).
4) Mobile device policy and whether laptops need to be logged out before arrival.

Attached: redwood-site-entry-checklist.xlsx — draft checklist we plan to follow at arrival and after-hours. If you prefer, we can provide a CSV with the pre-reg details to send to security directly.

If Dina or your security team prefers a different format or has a secure intake link, we can adapt. Goal: 2–3 minute check-in at the guard desk for execs.

Thanks — looking to confirm today so we can pre-register everyone and share flight ETAs.

Best,

Laura Bennett
Director, Customer Success | Redwood Inference

From: Elaine Ross <elaine.ross@bixbycorp.com>

Cc: Dina Patel <dina.patel@bixbycorp.com>, Bixby Security <security@bixbycorp.com>
Date: Sat, 12 Apr 2025 10:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Onsite visit playbook & badging plan for Bixby exec offsite

Hi Laura —

Thanks for the clear notes. Welcome — we’re excited to host Redwood. A few items from security:

- Pre-registration: we require full legal name, company, date of birth, and either the last 4 of passport or a government ID number. If you prefer, you may supply a PDF of the ID for verification; otherwise last-4 is acceptable.
- Photo requirement: yes, a headshot (JPEG) is required for the visitor badge. We can take a photo at the guard desk if needed, but pre-submitted photos speed things up.
- Escort: visitors to executive floors (levels 12–14) must be escorted by a Bixby host at all times.
- Devices & networks: guests are not permitted to plug into internal networks. Personal devices are allowed in public meeting areas; restricted labs have a signed waiver.
- Background checks: not required for a one-day exec visit, but any contractor staying >5 business days will need standard vendor onboarding checks.

Attached is our Bixby_badging_form.pdf — please complete and return for each attendee. Send photos as separate JPEGs labelled Firstname_Lastname.jpg. Dina Patel (cc) is the guard desk lead and will be the point-of-contact for entry.

Best,

Elaine Ross
Head of Executive Programs | Bixby Corp
elaine.ross@bixbycorp.com | +1 212-555-0891

Thanks Elaine —

We’ll collect the requested fields and photos. Quick internal coordination:

- Laura arrival confirmed 08:30 (SFO) — she volunteered to drop off the printed attendee list at the guard desk if needed.
- Stephanie arrives 09:15 and will meet in the lobby.

Action items for our side:
1) Laura to upload pre-reg CSV and photos to the secure folder (I can transfer to Dina).
2) Stephanie to confirm if she needs any device exemptions for the demo (we have a preconfigured laptop image; if the room is restricted, we’ll use a loaner).
3) Marcus to confirm whether we need an escort inside demo lab — I don’t think so for the exec sessions.

Laura — can you please send the CSV with the following columns: full_name, company, dob, id_last4, email, phone, photo_filename? I’ll drop everything with Dina by 05/02 EOD.

Also, do we have any VIP requests (e.g., parking pass for the C-suite, separate entrance)? If so, I’ll add to the pre-reg sheet.

—Marcus
